description: Verbs in a tool NAME that suggest the tool mutates state. Signal 2 of 3 for write capability, consulted only when annotations are absent. Matched against tokens after splitting the name on snake_case, camelCase, kebab-case and dots, so 'refundPayment', 'refund_payment' and 'payments.refund' all match 'refund'.
sourceNotes: Assembled from the tool names in the public MCP registry plus the verb list in the project brief. Deliberately excludes ambiguous verbs like 'get', 'list', 'search', 'find', 'read', 'describe', which appear in the read set below. Several entries here are also nouns — invoice, credit, debit, charge, post, code — so the classifier gives the LEADING token of a tool name precedence over a scan of the whole name; otherwise get_invoice would classify as a write on its object rather than a read on its verb. Disagreement with a specific verb is a supported activity: edit this file and re-run.
